annotations.text: League builder — third revision. The card takes three shades of its own type, read off the /vp/ template sheet: the build page's own section fill for the body, then two steps held at a constant perceived brightness so white glyphs read the same on every type (cells 4.2:1, bands 6.4:1 against white). Type colours are the repo's Gen IX badge palette, not Bulbapedia. Three bands: gym leader team, Elite Four and Champion, endgame boss. The top-left void holds the signature tile, the TM slot and the badge slot, each aligned to the glyph cells beside it.

League home. The tool header carries the page title; the body has no h1 of its own. Glyph column sits right of the teams, type chip last. The open slot's fill runs the full width of the card, through its gutters, with no outline — that is what lets the desktop flow leave it seamlessly. Elite Four slot 4 stacks its stars 2x2.

The card. Badge glyphs wrap after four and left-align once there are four or more. Elite Four & Champion share one band. The signature is the dex builder's standalone tile, titled inside and topped to the No badges cell. The TM and badge slots stop at the glyph cells' own edges. The type chip is the plain TypeBadge; pressing it opens the pane's type menu plus No type.

The dex builder's PokemonBrowser, reused as the component it is. Two differences only: a My dex filter, and a tap that places the line and closes the sheet with no confirm step. The card's type arrives pre-selected.

The TM slot opens a move picker on the same pane: type badge, move name, and the category icon, with filters for type and category and a search that sorts on move name. Power is data, not a filter. The category marks are drawn here — the official raster icons ship in no reachable mirror, so the build has to harvest them.

Desktop, at rest. Real panes with the seam showing, as the dex builder has it; each pane centres a phone-width column. League left, card right, joined by the flow out of the open row — the same fill colour, so the two meet without an edge.
Desktop, picker open. The selection pane comes in from the right and the layout becomes three panes, each still centring a phone-width column.
